subject: Urgent: Renewal at-risk — GreenHarbor payment & SLA sensitivity (approval needed)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal warning — GreenHarbor at EOS next week (need concession guidance)

Team,

Quick heads up — GreenHarbor (Elena Morales) replied last night that they are planning a wholesale downgrade at renewal unless we materially reduce list pricing and add a higher SLA (they cited latency incidents earlier this year). Current ARR at risk: ~$420k (annualized). They are asking for:

- 25% recurring discount for the next 12 months OR a term reset to 12 months at a lower TCV
- One-time make-good credit for Q2 latency exposure (they estimate $60k)
- SLA bump to 99.95% with credits for future incidents

I pushed for specifics and asked for a mutual action plan; Elena wants to see a written offer by COB Mon. Deal region: US.

I need guidance on what the deal desk / execs will entertain without full signoff and what qualifies for an exec concession. I attached the customer renewal brief and our proposed math (redwood-save-offer.xlsx).

Attachments: GreenHarbor_Renewal_Brief.pdf, redwood-save-offer.xlsx

Ask: Vivek/Rishi — recommend a short list of options (minimum viable concession to keep them on platform + economics). Laura — want to flag this for your awareness in case we escalate to an executive ask.

Thanks,
Camila
--
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal warning — GreenHarbor at EOS next week (need concession guidance)

Camila — thanks for the fast summary and attachments. Preliminary thoughts:

- We should avoid a pure recurring 25% list cut if possible. Consider a blended approach: 10–15% recurring discount + one-time credit to address their Q2 pain.
- Term reset to 12 months is reasonable if we couple it with a modest price concession and SLA add-on revenue (we can price SLA overlay as a separate SKU + credit if incident occurs).
- Approval thresholds: Legal/Finance can handle contract language; anything with a >20% recurring impact or >$50k one-time credit should route to senior execs.

Proposed offer to test with customer:
1) 15% recurring discount for 12 months (then revert to baseline)
2) $50k one-time credit as make-good (applied on next invoice)
3) SLA overlay priced at $X/mo with 99.95% target; include one free incident credit in first 12 months

Camila — can you populate the short executive brief (1 pager) with ARR at risk, expected retention delta, LTV impact and the requested concessions? Rishi/Laura — would appreciate quick thumbs on whether the $50k credit + 15% discount requires further signoff.

-Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal warning — GreenHarbor at EOS next week (need concession guidance)

Camila — good catch and thank you for the brief. I reviewed the numbers. A couple of guardrails and a recommended path:

1) Guardrails: Sales Ops can approve up to 20% recurring discount or $40k one-time credit without exec approval. Anything beyond that (25% recurring / $50k+) needs my signoff plus one senior exec (Laura or VP Sales).

2) Recommended final offer to present to customer (we should aim for this as the first written offer):
   - 12-month term reset with a 10% recurring discount (applies to current list for first 12 months)
   - One-time make-good credit: $50,000 (applied next invoice) — I can sign this but will need exec signoff on the combination if we go above 20% commuted impact
   - SLA add-on: 99.95% overlay priced separately at $7,500/month; include an incident credit policy (first qualifying incident credit = 100% credit of that month's SLA fee)

3) Rationale: Keeps headline concession off the recurring list, compensates for Q2 outage with a tangible credit, and opens route to monetize SLA as an add-on.

Camila — please draft the one-pager (covering ARR at risk, retention upside, alternatives if they refuse). If they insist on a 25% recurring reduction we escalate to Laura + CEO (notably higher bar).

-Rishi
--
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal warning — GreenHarbor at EOS next week (need concession guidance)

Per Rishi's notes, I prepared the one-pager and attached the fillable offer for exec review. Key numbers (TL;DR):

- ARR at risk: $420,000
- Expected retention lift if accepted: ~85% probability (net retained ARR ~ $357k)
- Option A (recommended): 12-month term reset + 10% recurring discount + $50k one-time credit + SLA overlay at $7.5k/mo
- Option B (conservative): 15% recurring discount + $40k one-time credit (finance prefers this)

I've uploaded: GreenHarbor_Renewal_Brief.pdf (1-pager), redwood-save-offer.xlsx (price lines). Also prepared DocuSign package: GH-DocuSign-Offer-20261001.pdf (link below).

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/preview/GH-2026-042-offer

Camila — can you confirm that the $50k credit will be booked as a contra-revenue credit and accepted by finance? Markus — tagging you for revenue recognition / finance permission for the $50k contra. Laura — appreciate a quick signoff or escalation note if you want the CEO looped. Customer expects a formal offer by Monday.

Thanks,
Camila
--
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal warning — GreenHarbor at EOS next week (need concession guidance)

Thank you for the clear brief — good work. Approvals and conditions below:

1) I approve the term reset to 12 months, and I authorize the SLA overlay at the proposed price subject to legal sign-off on the incident credit language.

2) For credits/discounts: I will authorize a one-time $50k credit on the condition that we structure the deal as Option A but move the recurring discount to 15% (not 10%). Net concession math should stay within finance tolerances. Camila — please update the offer to 15% recurring + $50k one-time credit.

3) Markus — please confirm finance can accept a $50k contra and provide guidance on revenue deferral / recognition. This approval is conditional on finance confirmation.

4) Legal: no non-standard indemnities. Any SLA language changes must be limited to add-on doc and not change baseline contract exposure.

If finance/legal are aligned I want this out as the official offer to GreenHarbor by EOD Monday. If GreenHarbor pushes for 25% recurring we escalate to execs (I will loop in the CRO).

-Laura
--
Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
